answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on four widely-used benchmark datasets to evaluate POSPD: XSUM for text summarization, ROCStories corpus for story ending generation, SQuAD 1.1 for question generation, and WMT14 (DE-EN) for machine translation.
answer_1.outputs: generated text outputs in various NLG tasks such as summaries, story endings, questions, and translations

answer_2.quote: Follow GLGE , we use ROUGE-1 (R-1), ROUGE-2 (R-2), and ROUGE-L (R-L) as evaluation metrics for text summarization, while BLEU-4 (B-4) , Meteor (Denkowski and Lavie, 2014), and R-L are used in question generation and story ending generation. Meanwhile, BLEU-4 is also the evaluation metric for machine translation to keep in line with previous works .
